name: 西游记2006之最终幻想
english_name: Journey to the West 2006: Final Fantasy (AKAI Studio / Tomud)
english_description: Another branch of AKAI Studio's Tomud-branded Journey to the West line, sibling to this archive's xyj2006n (identical file structure and bugs). It uses the same connection handshake: the very first line sent must be the bare literal "2060" (the automatic reply from Tomud/Smiling Proud Wanderer clients), or the connection is treated as an illegal client and dropped.
